original_record.question_en: List the TR studies targeting Rel-18 and the type of impact each had on the TSs.
original_record.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, tr.trStatus, ti.impactType, sp.specNumber ORDER BY tr.trNumber

original_Korean_record.question: Rel-18을 타겟으로 하는 TR 연구 목록과 각 연구가 TS에 미친 영향 유형은?
original_Korean_record.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, tr.trStatus, ti.impactType, sp.specNumber ORDER BY tr.trNumber

natural_requested_roles: All retained Rel18-targeting study identities and actual type(s) of their effects on TSs. Study-release selector does not constrain the later normative effect release; original title/status are diagnostic context.
